messages.subject: mark-recapture same bird, different sites
parts:
This is not a coding issue, more of a general "what do i do?"

We have been capturing/resighting sparrows during three winter capture windows to get winter survival with Cormack-Jolly-Seber models. The capture windows are usually 1-2 weeks so we can accommodate multiple sites from North Carolina to Delaware. All of the resights/recaptures that we have had until now were at the site that they were originally banded. However, last week we captured a bird in Virginia and then recaptured the same bird at a different site a few days later in Delaware. 

I am not sure exactly how to handle this bird as we are using latitude and a site-specific vegetation index as covariates. Can anyone point me to a paper where something like this happened? I think it is unusual but this cant be the first time a bird has flown from one study site to the next in a short period of time.
